browser_click.description: Click one matching element; optionally select a newly opened tab.

browser_close.description: Close the selected page; cancel its pending dialog action.

browser_console_messages.description: Read captured console messages, optionally filtered by level.

browser_cookie_clear.description: Clear cookie in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_cookie_delete.description: Delete cookie in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_cookie_get.description: Get cookie in the task-owned browser; returns found and value (null when absent).

browser_cookie_list.description: List cookie in the task-owned browser; returns entries collection.

browser_cookie_set.description: Set cookie in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_dialog_status.description: Read armed, handled, expired, failed or cancelled dialog action status.

browser_evaluate.description: Execute a page function with optional JSON arg. JSON results only; source64KiB/result1MiB, timeout10s/max25s. Timeout closes target page.

browser_file_upload.description: Select local task-workspace or base64 files in a file input. 10 files,16MiB each,32MiB total,1MiB inline. Returns selected filenames,size and SHA256.

browser_fill_form.description: Validate all controls then fill fields sequentially; failures include completed field indices.

browser_get_config.description: Read browser contract version and managed browser configuration.

browser_handle_dialog.description: Arm accept/dismiss for the next dialog on this page (10s default, 25s maximum); returns dialog_action_id.

browser_localstorage_clear.description: Clear localstorage in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_localstorage_delete.description: Delete localstorage in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_localstorage_get.description: Get localstorage in the task-owned browser; returns found and value (null when absent).

browser_localstorage_list.description: List localstorage in the task-owned browser; returns entries collection.

browser_localstorage_set.description: Set localstorage in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_mouse_click_xy.description: Perform mouse click xy on the selected page.

browser_mouse_down.description: Perform mouse down on the selected page.

browser_mouse_move_xy.description: Perform mouse move xy on the selected page.

browser_mouse_up.description: Perform mouse up on the selected page.

browser_mouse_wheel.description: Perform mouse wheel on the selected page; without x/y it uses the viewport center.

browser_navigate.description: Navigate the selected page to an HTTP(S) URL and wait for the requested load state.

browser_navigate_back.description: Navigate one step back in page history.

browser_network_request.description: Read an indexed request, response or both; missing indices fail.

browser_network_requests.description: Read captured HTTP request indices and optional original headers.

browser_pdf_save.description: Render PDF metadata; optionally include data or save managed evidence.

browser_press_key.description: Press a keyboard key or key combination on the selected page.

browser_resize.description: Set the viewport width and height in CSS pixels.

browser_select_option.description: Select option values in a select control.

browser_session_close.description: Close managed Chrome, bridge and proxy; report cleanup failures.

browser_session_create.description: Create a managed Chrome session bound to the trusted Host assignment.

browser_session_get.description: Read managed session health and process status.

browser_sessionstorage_clear.description: Clear sessionstorage in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_sessionstorage_delete.description: Delete sessionstorage in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_sessionstorage_get.description: Get sessionstorage in the task-owned browser; returns found and value (null when absent).

browser_sessionstorage_list.description: List sessionstorage in the task-owned browser; returns entries collection.

browser_sessionstorage_set.description: Set sessionstorage in the task-owned browser; returns completed and affected count.

browser_snapshot.description: Read the accessibility snapshot of the page or a strict locator.

browser_storage_state.description: Read cookie and local storage state for this managed browser context.

browser_tabs.description: List, create, select or close a tab using stable page_id.

browser_take_screenshot.description: Capture PNG metadata; optionally include data or save managed evidence.

browser_type.description: Fill a text control, optionally type sequentially and submit.

browser_verify_element_visible.description: Check visibility of one strictly matching element.

browser_verify_list_visible.description: Check expected texts inside exactly one container.

browser_verify_value.description: Compare control value, checked state or selected option values.

browser_wait_for.description: Wait for a duration, locator state, visible text or disappearing text within one deadline.
